solutions.title: Sorted dynamic array
solutions.strategy: Insert each new number into its sorted position and read the middle value or average from the sorted sequence.

timeComplexity.explanation: Binary search finds the insertion index, but shifting array elements costs O(n). Median lookup reads one or two middle indices.

spaceComplexity.explanation: All stream values are retained in sorted order.

solutions.title: Two balanced heaps
solutions.strategy: Keep the smaller half in a max heap and the larger half in a min heap, rebalancing sizes after each insert.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each insertion performs a constant number of heap pushes/pops. Median lookup reads heap tops.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The two heaps together store every value added to the stream.
